Menu count 17/17. **Maintenance:** upstairs bathroom sink pooling black water during cleanup (photo in maintenance chat).

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Friday 11/13 (MOD Josh; entered by Josh; posted 4:32am 11/14)** Net $10,069.75 (form 'Total Net Sales Including Events') vs target $10,119 (99.5%). Marquee bar $8,371.75, Garden $1,823; total sales $10,194.75; food $1,430; comps $125. 197 guests; check avg $51.12 (net/guests; form GCA $45.36). Garden quiet until ~7:40pm, then a push of larger parties rotated inside to clear the waitlist; Jada held the Garden solo; closed by 12:15am. Marquee steady start to finish with larger parties and some long-staying guests; two servers; a stretch with both servers off the floor caused delays — need better comms before stepping away. Kitchen busy with quick ticket times (potatoes, oysters lead). Carajillo night. Kitchen close not checked. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Maintenance: curtains.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 11/13 (AM Sam & Lex; PM James & Shannon; entered by Alexis; posted 2:41am 11/14)** Net $15,098 vs target $14,404 (105%). Morning bar $4,199, evening bar $7,784, Hot Eye $3,059; Sun Club closed; no events; food $4,656; comps $304 (2.0%). 323 guests (72 AM + 251 PM OpenTable); check avg $46.74 (net/guests). Slow morning, then early afternoon kicked into gear with food tours, walk-ins and travelers arriving for a busy weekend. Evening steady; a movie across the street packed the restaurant through dinner; 251 covers with no support. Hot Eye: wedding party of 15–20 early, lull, then a bigger wedding party from ~10:30pm kept it busy till lights-on. Shannon ran expo; no send-backs. **Maintenance: bathrooms need major attention.** No incidents.
